title: AIWG Project Configuration
description: Configuration file for the AIWG AI coding assistant framework

scripts.description: Named scripts runnable via AIWG sidebar or CLI

workspace.description: General multi-repository workspace metadata. Root manifests pair this with repos; external members may use member_of to discover their workspace.

repos.description: Workspace member repositories. Each member's own .aiwg/aiwg.config remains authoritative for remotes, delivery, tracker actor, and signing.

externalLinks.description: Named public external resources exposed as project metadata. AIWG renders these links but does not fetch them or submit data.

remotes.description: Repo origin topology — declares primary (CI/issues/PRs) and secondary remotes (#994)

primary.description: git remote name driving CI/PRs by default. Defaults to 'origin' when absent.

issue_tracker.description: Where issues live. Defaults to primary.

ci.description: Where CI runs. Defaults to primary.

tracker_actor.description: Forge account/tool that must author delivery writes such as issue comments, PRs, labels, and closures (#1601).

secondary.description: Mirrors, fork bases, and publishing targets

issues.description: Issue-tracker workflow semantics associated with remotes.issue_tracker (#1789). Ordinary issue processing validates but never implicitly provisions labels.

labels.description: Tracker labels keyed by stable semantic role.

repo_maintainer.description: Role-aware repository maintenance overrides. Forge permission detection is attempted first; these tiers pin or narrow behavior when detection is denied or policy requires a fixed posture (#1755).

tiers.description: Map remote URLs, owner/repo slugs, remote names, or 'local' to collaborator, maintainer, or admin.

delivery.description: Repo control / delivery policy — how AIWG agents are expected to ship code (#995)

mode.description: How agents deliver code. direct = commit/push to default_branch; feature-branch = push branch, no PR; pr-required = branch + PR (default)

branch_naming.description: Branch-naming conventions. {issue} and {slug} are interpolated by skills.

prefix_by_type.description: Per commit-type branch prefix templates (feat, fix, docs, chore, refactor, test)

delete_branch_on_merge.description: Delete the feature branch after merge. Default true.

require_ci_green.description: Agent must wait for CI green before declaring done. Default true.

committer.description: Committer identity agents should use for delivery commits. Defaults to git config when unset.

auto_close_issues.description: Include 'Closes #N' in PR body. Default true.

issue_comment_on_cycle.description: Post AL CYCLE status comments to issue threads. Default true.

parallelism.description: Provider-scoped parallelism caps — limits concurrent subagents, Ralph loops, and MC missions to keep AIWG within the rate-limit envelope of the underlying model provider (#1359). Composes (effective limit = MIN) with context-budget caps and rlm-context-management Rule 8.

max_parallel_subagents.description: Max concurrent subagents (Task dispatches, rlm-batch fan-outs). Default: provider-specific (claude=4, codex/copilot/etc.=10).

max_parallel_ralph_loops.description: Max concurrent Ralph external loops. Default: provider-specific (claude=2, others=3).

max_parallel_mc_missions.description: Max concurrent Mission Control missions. Default: provider-specific (claude=4, others=6).

rationale.description: Free-form note explaining why this cap was chosen (e.g., 'Claude Team plan API quota').

index.description: Artifact-index configuration — graph definitions (#1491). Consolidated here from the legacy .aiwg/config.yaml per ADR adr-index-config-consolidation.

graphs.description: Index graph definitions. Each key (except 'indices') is a JSON node/edge graph (IndexGraphDef); 'indices' holds the markdown-view manifest (IndexMarkdownIndices) rendered by corpus-index-build.

userIndices.description: Controls whether user/global index sidecars are included by default in merged capability discovery/show.

enabled.description: When false, default capability discovery/show omit user/global sidecars unless --graph user is selected explicitly.

indices.description: User/global index shorthand. Declares shared sidecar roots that can be used from any project.

enabled.description: When false, default capability discovery/show omit user/global sidecars unless selected explicitly.

roots.description: Named user-level index roots. Each key becomes an addressable shared graph name.

path.description: Filesystem path for this user-level index root. Supports ~ expansion.

backend.description: Preferred backend for this root. AIWG still builds the local graph before Fortemi sync.

extensions.description: File extensions to index. Defaults to markdown, YAML, and JSON.

corpusRoot.description: Corpus root directory (relative to project root or absolute). Default: project root. The corpus lives under <corpusRoot>/documentation/{references,citations,radar,profiles}.

command_log.description: Optional local-first CLI command invocation log (#1614). Off by default.

enabled.description: Enable command invocation logging for this project. Default false.

scopes.description: Stores to write. project = .aiwg/telemetry/cli-commands.jsonl; global = XDG state.

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes per JSONL store before rotation to .1. Default 1048576.

telemetry.description: Local-first telemetry settings. All telemetry is off by default.

skill_usage.description: Optional local-first skill, agent, and command usage tracking (#1649). Off by default.

enabled.description: Enable skill usage tracking for this project. Default false.

scopes.description: Stores to write. project = .aiwg/telemetry/skill-usage.jsonl; global = XDG state.

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes per JSONL store before rotation to .1. Default 1048576.

name.description: Stable workspace name. Required by runtime validation when repos is present.

root.description: Base directory for relative member paths. Relative values resolve from the repo containing this config; defaults to that repo.

member_of.description: Optional member-to-workspace back-reference. External repos can use this to discover workspace authorization when invoked directly; must not coexist with repos.

path.description: Path relative to workspace.root, or an absolute system path.

allowed.description: Explicit member capabilities. Unlisted actions and unlisted paths are denied regardless of filesystem writability.

provider.description: Optional hint for self-hosted domains that cannot be classified from their remote URL. Detectable remotes take precedence.

ExternalLink.description: A named public HTTP(S) resource. Credentials embedded in URLs are rejected by runtime validation.

url.description: Absolute public HTTP(S) URL without embedded credentials.

description.description: Optional explanation of when or why to use this resource.

category.description: Optional project-defined grouping, such as security, status, or docs.

audience.description: Optional intended audience, such as contributors or maintainers.

IssueLabelDefinition.description: Provider-neutral workflow semantics for one tracker-native label.

provider_names.description: Optional provider-specific strings that preserve this semantic role.

category.description: Informative role family used for search, audit, batching, and work selection.

requires_human.description: Whether satisfying this state requires human action.

blocks_automation.description: Whether autonomous issue work must pause while this label applies.

resume_when.description: Condition that permits removal or transition of a transient label; required by runtime validation when blocks_automation is true.

transition_to.description: Optional semantic role to apply after resume_when is satisfied.

login.description: Forge login that should author delivery writes.

via.description: Tooling route to use for tracker writes.

forbid_actors.description: Forge logins that must not author delivery mutations.

key_file.description: Path to signing key material when not in the default keyring.

program.description: Signing program, such as gpg, gpg2, ssh-keygen, or a custom path.

IndexGraphDef.description: A JSON node/edge index graph (mirrors GraphConfig in src/artifacts/types.ts).

type.description: Graph type identifier (defaults to the graph's key name).

scanDirs.description: Directories to scan, relative to project root (required).

shared.description: Whether the graph is shared across projects. Default false.

defaultBuild.description: Include in `aiwg index build` with no --graph. Default true.

filenamePattern.description: Named-capture regex for the filename-metadata strategy.

description.description: Human-facing note (metadata; not consumed by the builder).

IndexMarkdownIndices.description: Markdown-view manifest rendered by the corpus-index-build skill (build.py). The builder consumes each manifest entry's `name` (renderer selector) and optional `output`.

manifest.description: Ordered list of markdown views to render.

name.description: Renderer selector (by-topic, by-year, authors, by-venue, by-method, by-model-size, training-pipeline, citation-network, by-author, by-org, by-bridge, unprofiled-hubs).

SecondaryRemote.description: A non-primary git remote (mirror, upstream, publishing target)

name.description: Must match a name from `git remote`

push_on_release.description: Hint to release workflows to push tags here on stable cuts

InstalledFramework.description: Metadata for an installed AIWG framework

providers.description: Providers this framework was deployed to
